'''Mainland Boulevard''' was a roadway in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that that ran north to south. Located west of the [[Enterprise Commons]], the Boulevard terminated at [[Aegis Base]] to the north, and joined [[Capital Way]] at its southern end.<ref name="TOR" />
